LANDFILL FIRE SMOKE

The Quezon City and Manila LGUs issued separate advisories on Saturday, April 11, as air quality worsened across parts of Metro Manila due to smoke from a fire at an inactive waste disposal site in Navotas.

The Bureau of Fire Protection said the blaze broke out Friday night at the landfill in Barangay Tanza 2 and affected nearby communities, including parts of Malabon and Obando, Bulacan, as firefighters struggled to contain the fire due to access limitations at the site.

Authorities said the fire, which continued to emit thick smoke, prompted the distribution of face masks and health advisories for residents in affected coastal areas.

The smoke drifted across Metro Manila, contributing to deteriorating air quality and prompting local government warnings for vulnerable groups to limit outdoor exposure.

Related: https://t.co/kdiKlzkgcY
